# Gold Wash Plants

> Custom gold wash plants and placer mining equipment built in the USA. Portable equipment with a 95-98% gold recovery rate. Mercury-free. Ships worldwide.

## Equipment
- M50 portable gold wash plant (50 tons per hour)
- 100 ton gold wash plant (100 tons per hour)
- 200 ton gold wash plant (M200T, 200 tons per hour)
- 300 ton gold wash plant (300 tons per hour)
- Custom-built placer mining equipment
- Worldwide shipping and setup guidance

## Why buyers choose it
- 95-98% gold recovery rate
- Mercury-free recovery
- Portable, custom-built to the operation
- Built in the USA
- Ships worldwide, including Africa, South America and Australia
- Our wash plants are all-in-one systems — they handle screening, classification, and gold recovery in a single portable unit. You don't need separate equipment. Just hook up water, feed material, and start recovering gold.
